versions.changelog:
- Added an "Example Prompts" section to clarify how to use the skill.
- No changes to feature set, workflow, or safety boundaries.
- Documentation improvements only; skill logic remains unchanged.

Initial release of Gift-Idea Match Board skill.

- Enables privacy-light gift planning by mapping recipients, occasions, interests, constraints, and idea candidates.
- Avoids collecting or storing sensitive personal data, providing financial advice, or using shopping/affiliate links.
- Organizes gift ideas using fit scores, effort levels, and confirmation flags for practical and thoughtful selection.
- Provides a reusable board format, with checklists and notes for future occasions.
- Designed to help users plan gifts thoughtfully without shopping pressure or intrusive profiling.
